text: 据同花顺iFinD数据，截至目前，南向资金净买入超80亿港元，其中港股通（沪）买入超63.37亿港元，港股通（深）买入超17.01亿港元。
text_en: According to Tonghuashun iFinD data, as of now, southbound capital net buying exceeds HK$8 billion, with Stock Connect (Shanghai) buying over HK$6.337 billion and Stock Connect (Shenzhen) buying over HK$1.701 billion.
